title: Exact Beck–Fiala \(t\)-bound
statement: Exact Beck–Fiala \(t\)-bound · 1981. Beck and Fiala conjectured discrepancy at most \(t\) when every element occurs in at most \(t\) sets (historical form).

counterexample.description: Give a bounded-column-sum incidence matrix for which no sign vector keeps every row imbalance at most \(t\). SAT/DRAT certifies all colorings.
